note: 保護区 means a nature or wildlife preserve specifically. 保留地 is glossed as a reservation or set-aside area in JMdict (ent_seq 2865625 sense 0), closer to land reserved for a purpose generally.
失敗作 means a failed work such as a book or film, while the English sense also includes people and endeavors; no single Japanese noun covers those referents.
書簡 is directly glossed as correspondence as well as letters and notes, matching postal or other written communications in this sense.
泡立てる specifically means beat or whisk to create foam. かき混ぜる means mix or stir in JMdict (ent_seq 1589980 sense 0) and better fits rapid mixing generally.
定期購読 is limited to subscriptions such as magazines. サブスクリプション is the general subscription noun in JMdict (ent_seq 2497990 sense 0), including resource access for a period.
流れ出る covers flowing or pouring out, but not abundant falling such as heavy rain; the English definition bundles distinct intransitive uses without one exact Japanese equivalent.
数列 is limited to numerical sequences. 列 has a general sequence sense in JMdict (ent_seq 1558330 sense 2), matching an ordered list of objects.
特価品 is specifically a retailer's sale item. 掘り出し物 means a bargain, good buy, or lucky find in JMdict (ent_seq 1603580 sense 0).
テレックス and viễn tín are valid terms for the teletype network, even though the technology and Vietnamese term are dated.
荒らす has a direct web-forum trolling sense; the online discussion and inflammatory-post context selects it over broader forms of vandalism or spam.
クッキー and bánh quy are ordinary equivalents for a small flat baked good; Vietnamese does not sharply divide the American cookie and biscuit categories.
ヘロイン and bạch phiến both correctly name heroin; the Vietnamese term is standard though the international loanword is also used.
牙 includes tusk as well as fang, and the definition specifically describes elongated teeth protruding outside an animal's mouth; ngà is the matching Vietnamese term.
椿 most directly names Camellia japonica, while the English definition is the entire Camellia genus, including the tea plant; no verified broader Japanese headword was found offline.
ぼたん usually means tree peony specifically, whereas the English definition covers the entire Paeonia genus; no verified general Japanese equivalent was found offline.
屋台店 and gian hàng both denote a stall or stand where merchandise is displayed for sale; gian hàng is a natural Vietnamese equivalent.
ビロード and nhung both mean velvet. The Japanese word is less common today than ベルベット but remains a correct equivalent.
蜂 and ong are the common terms for bees; the source sense simply identifies the animal as an insect, and ordinary context selects bee.
可愛がる is directly glossed as fondle, caress, or pet, matching touching or stroking lovingly in this sense.
ソフトドリンク can include any nonalcoholic drink. 炭酸飲料 means carbonated drink in JMdict (ent_seq 1629060 sense 0), matching the sweet, carbonated beverage definition more closely.
Rạp usually means a cinema, theater, or tent. Nhà trưng bày specifies a structure housing exhibits at a fair or similar event.
青銅 and đồng thanh both correctly name bronze, the copper alloy usually combined with tin or other metals.
Máy sao chụp is technically correct but uncommon in daily use. Máy photocopy is the familiar Vietnamese term for a photocopier.
引き渡し means handing over generally but is also the established Japanese legal term for extradition; the government-to-government process in the definition selects that sense.
Trần means bare or naked generally. Để trần thân trên specifies not wearing a garment over the upper half of the body.
Phá hủy means destroy broadly. Phá dỡ is the natural Vietnamese verb for deliberately dismantling or demolishing buildings and similar structures.
プラカード usually means a placard carried by a person, while áp phích is a wall poster; the English definition covers a display sheet or card without either format restriction.
あじさい most directly identifies bigleaf hydrangea, while the English definition explicitly covers several species of the full Hydrangea genus.
Tiêu đề is a general title or heading. Tiêu đề bài báo specifies the brief line drawing attention to a newspaper or magazine article.
庭師 usually suggests a professional landscape gardener. ガーデナー means gardener in JMdict (ent_seq 2668640 sense 0), also covering someone who gardens as a hobby.
隕石 and thiên thạch are standard equivalents for a metallic or stony body that is a meteorite; the scientific definition selects the meteorite sense.
熊手 often refers to a bamboo rake. レーキ is the general garden or wheeled rake in JMdict (ent_seq 1144270 sense 0).
引き渡す is directly glossed as extradite as well as hand over; the legal process between states selects the specific sense.
Máu trắng is colloquial. Bệnh bạch cầu is the standard Vietnamese medical term for leukemia.
キジ refers most directly to the Japanese green pheasant, whereas the English definition is the full Phasianidae family; no verified general Japanese equivalent was found offline.
チャーハン specifically means Chinese-style fried rice. 焼き飯 is glossed as fried rice in JMdict (ent_seq 1742840 sense 0) and is broader across styles.
ブレード and lưỡi both mean the sharp working end of a knife or other cutting tool; the English definition gives this precise sense.
問う is directly glossed as call into question, doubt, and question, matching the stated act of introducing doubt.
Xe đẩy means a push cart generally. Xe đẩy siêu thị specifically identifies the conveyance used to carry items while shopping in a store.
軽率 implies thoughtlessness or rashness. 性急 means hasty, hurried, or rushed in JMdict (ent_seq 1375310 sense 0), matching excessive speed.
